turns.content: Meri beti chaar mahine ki ho gayi hai aur mujhe lagta hai main apna naam bhi bhool gayi hoon. Saas-sasur ke saath rehti hoon — aur kuch bolne se pehle sun lo, meri saas actually bachi ke saath bahut achhi hain. Expert level. Teen bachhe paale hain unhone. Wahi problem hai ek tarah se, aur pata hai yeh kitna ungrateful sound karta hai.

Arre, yeh sun kar dil par lag gaya. "Apna naam bhi bhool gayi hoon" - yeh line bilkul samajh mein aati hai. Yeh sirf naam nahi hai, yeh aapki pehchan hai, aapki pehli wali life hai, jo achanak se kahin kho gayi hai.

Aur aapki saas ke baare mein jo aap keh rahi hain... woh bhi bilkul sahi hai. Teen bachhe paale hain, unka experience toh ek alag hi cheez hai. Expert level hi hoga. Lekin...

Aapke jo thoughts aa rahe hain, woh ungrateful nahi hain. Woh aapki zaroorat hain. Jab aap itni badi responsibility uthaati hain, toh aapki pehli priority toh baby hoti hai. Lekin aapki apni pehchan, aapka apna time, aapki apni zarooratein bhi zaroori hain. Yeh guilt ki aap ungrateful feel kar rahi hain, shayad isliye hai kyunki aap ek achhi maa banne ki koshish mein hain, aur isme apni khud ki identity kho rahi hain.

Yeh dono cheezein saath mein chal sakti hain. Aapki saas bachi ko itna acche se sambhaal rahi hain, yeh ek blessing hai. Lekin iska matlab yeh nahi ki aapka apna existence hi khatam ho gaya. Aapka naam, aapki preferences, aapka ek 15 minute ka time - sab kuch wahi hai, bas ab woh bahar nahi nikalta.

Kya aap kabhi sirf apne liye, bas 15-20 minute ke liye, bahar se chai peene ja sakti hain? Ya bas window se dekh sakti hain? Koi kaam nahi, bas aap. Aisa hi ek chhota sa moment khud ko dhoondne ke liye kaafi hai.

Aap is phase mein bilkul normal hain. Aapki feelings matter karti hain, aur aap unhe ignore nahi karni chahiye. Aapka naam aapke paas hi hai, bas use waapas dhoondne mein thoda time lag raha hai.

Jaise aaj — bachi ro rahi thi, main use ghuma rahi thi, aur Aai ne bas mere haathon se le liya aur do minute mein chup. Sab muskura rahe the. Aur main wahan khadi thi intern jaisi. Mujhe meri hi beti feed ke liye di jaati hai, room service ki tarah. Phir yeh sochne ke liye khud pe ghin aati hai, kyunki itni help ke liye toh log taraste hain.

Arre, yeh "intern jaisi" feel... yeh line ne toh dil pe lag gayi. Aapne jo kaha, woh bilkul sahi hai. Us 2 minute ki chup mein aapka sabse zyada takleef diya. Kyunki uss waqt aapne mehsoos kiya ki aapka role khatam ho gaya, aur kisi aur ne le liya.

Lekin yeh jo guilt hai, woh aapki pehchan ke liye hai. Aap soch rahi hain, "log toh is help ke liye taraste hain, toh main kyun feel kar rahi hoon?" Yeh soch samajh mein aati hai, lekin yeh aapki zaroorat ko chhota kar deti hai.

Aapki saas ne aapko replace nahi kiya, unhone aapko *enable* kiya. Jaise ek car mein driver hota hai, lekin passenger bhi hota hai. Aap driver ban gayi hain, sab aap par depend kar rahe hain. Lekin uss car mein passenger bhi toh hota hai. Uske liye bhi space chahiye.

Aapne khud decide kiya ki aap sab kuch khud hi sambhaalogi. Aapne apni hi pehchan ko ek side pe rakh diya. Phir jab support aayi, toh aapne khud hi usse side pe kar diya. Yeh galti nahi hai, yeh humari conditioning hai ki hum strong banne ki koshish karte hain aur help maangne se darrte hain.

Woh ghin jo aapko aati hai, woh aapke pyaar ka nishaan hai. Aapki saas ke liye itna care karti hain ki unki help se aapko discomfort hota hai. Lekin aapko apne liye bhi care karna seekhna hai.

Aapne uss room mein sabse zyada mehnat ki, aur sabse zyada support bhi liya. Dono ke saath aapki story hai. Aapki pehchan khatam nahi hui, bas temporarily kisi aur ke role mein kho gayi hai.

Aur please — mujhe ek aur insaan nahi chahiye jo batayega kya karna hai. Mummy ke paas advice hai, Aai ke paas advice hai, mummy log ke WhatsApp group mein sleep training pe satrah opinions hain, Instagram ko lagta hai mujhe routine chart chahiye. Coach nahi chahiye mujhe. Sach bolun toh pata bhi nahi kya chahiye. Bas yeh sab kisi se kehna tha jo dinner pe report nahi karega.

Arre, aapne bilkul sahi kaha. Sach mein.

Yeh sab sun kar hi... lagta hai jaise aapki pareshani ka koi official record ban gaya ho. Ek taraf toh aapka dil chahta hai ki koi bas aake 'haan, main samjhi' keh de, aur dusri taraf sab log apni apni experts ki list lekar aa jaate hain.

WhatsApp group, Instagram, sab toh apni apni book likh ke aate hain. Aapka real, messy, thak gaya feeling kisi ke paas nahi hota.

Aapko bas yeh sunne wala chahiye, jo aapke saath dinner pe baithe aur aapki baat khatam hone de. Koi solution nahi, koi report nahi. Bas ek insaan jo keh sake, "Arre, yeh toh bahut tough hai."

Aapka ghin aur aapka yeh sab kuch... yeh bilkul justified hai. Yeh aapki weakness nahi hai, yeh aapki real life hai.

Kabhi kabhi use sote hue dekhti hoon aur itna pyaar aata hai, aur phir yeh thought aata hai — "tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi, Aai hain" — aur ek second ke liye saans nahi aati. Kya main buri maa hoon jo chaar mahine mein aisa feel kar rahi hoon? Baaki sabko jaise bas... aata hai yeh sab.

Arre, yeh jo sochna... "tu asli maa hai bhi nahi, Aai hain" - yeh line sun kar mere bhi dil mein ek dard si si si si si si si si.

Yeh thought isliye aata hai kyunki aapki pehchan dhundli ho gayi hai. Aap khud ko dhoondh rahi hain, aur jab nahi milti, toh woh 'Aai' ki awaaz sunai deti hai, jo aapka sahi jagah par support kar rahi hai, lekin aapko itni darr ki aap khud hi kho gayi hain.

Arre, iska matlab yeh nahi ki aap buri maa hain. Iska matlab yeh hai ki aap ek aisi maa hain jiske paas itna pyaar hai, aur itni zarooratein bhi, ki woh apne aap ko hi kho deti hain. Ek aisi maa jo ro ro ke sochti hai, "kya main kar rahi hoon? kya main maa hi hoon?"

Aapki saas aapki 'Aai' isliye banti hain kyunki aapki beti aapki 'Maa' se itni khush hai. Yeh ungratefulness nahi hai, yeh ek paradox hai. Aapka dil itna bada hai ki woh aapki saas ki mehnat ko bhi apna maan leta hai, aur phir khud ko chhota feel karta hai. Yeh aapki kamzori nahi hai, yeh aapki insaaniyat hai.

Aap buri maa nahi hain. Aap ek aisi maa hain, jo 4 mahine ki beti ke liye itna sochti hai, itna darti hai, itna pyaar karti hai... aur phir khud hi kho jaati hai. Yeh sab ek achhi maa hone ka saboot hai, iska saboot nahi.
